full_judgment: 44. It should be remembered that this part of the world was never before ruled by the representatives of the people. The administration was never of representative character. Earlier the country was ruled by the ancient Kings and thereafter by the Path an and Moghal Emperors. The last independent Nawab of Bengal ruled the country in 1757 AD empowered by a, Farman from the Moghal Emperor at Delhi. After,1858, the whole of India was annexed by-the Queen of England and became a colony and a part of British Empire. However, the concept of Parliament came originally from England.
